A.meaning: One non-frozen test-file import relocation is sufficient to remove the known import-time collection blocker. Execution safety remains separate.

B.meaning: No module was proven to require multiple non-frozen test files or a shared test helper changed; this is not evidence that all other modules are one-file safe.

C.meaning: Frozen issuer is transitive import and runtime dependency; separate issuer/lifecycle-boundary review required. A frozen edit is not established as necessary for collection.

D.meaning: Static evidence does not yet justify a safe scoped collection-and-execution isolation patch; plausible lazy imports are not treated as test-pass proof.
